parameters.query:
-- Active supply of the customer for the given type, with its latest reading.
-- Zero rows => 404. One row with last_value NULL => first reading.
SELECT
    s.id          AS supply_id,
    s.meter_code,
    r.value       AS last_value,
    r.read_at     AS last_read_at
FROM customers c
JOIN supplies s            ON s.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN meter_readings r ON r.supply_id = s.id
WHERE c.customer_code = $1
  AND s.type = $2
  AND s.active = true
ORDER BY r.read_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.id DESC
LIMIT 1;

-- Idempotent insert: duplicate request_id => no row, RETURNING yields nothing.
INSERT INTO meter_readings (supply_id, value, source, request_id)
VALUES ($1, $2::numeric, 'voice_agent', $3)
ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, value, read_at;

parameters.responseBody:
={{ $json.id
  ? {
      registered: true,
      duplicate: false,
      reading_id: Number($json.id),
      value: Number($json.value),
      read_at: $json.read_at,
      supply_type: $('Validate request').item.json.supply_type,
      meter_code: $('Get supply').item.json.meter_code,
      previous_value: $('Get supply').item.json.last_value === null ? null : Number($('Get supply').item.json.last_value)
    }
  : {
      registered: true,
      duplicate: true,
      message: 'This reading was already registered for the same request',
      request_id: $('Validate request').item.json.request_id
    } }}
